note: REST pagination on commits/{sha}/status was unbounded (GitHub defaults to 30/page, harness_gate_read.py itself does not paginate it either) -- could silently misclassify a paginated-away harness/fable-gate context as never-posted. _describe_cause's required-check-red text falsely claimed 'a real verdict was posted and it is not success' even when fable_gate_state=='success' (the documented #4543 stale-check-vs-late-verdict shape). An empty commits.nodes on an open PR (anomalous GraphQL response, never legitimate) was silently treated as normal data instead of raising. fetch_open_prs' MAX_PAGES exhaustion warned and returned a PARTIAL PR list instead of raising, letting main() exit 0 on a silently-incomplete board. All 4 fixed same-session in queue_stall_classifier.py, independently re-verified by the reporting session via fresh pytest + py_compile + ruff runs.

BLOCKER: find_named_check_conclusion returned the first match over a list that can legitimately contain TWO checkRuns sharing HARNESS_FLOOR_CHECK_NAME on the same commit (a workflow_dispatch rerun lands in a different check suite than the original pull_request run, per the Agent PR Contract's own rule 3) -- order-dependent on GraphQL's unspecified checkSuites ordering, could either fabricate or swallow a real gate-verdict-missing. BLOCKER: RED_CHECK_CONCLUSIONS=(FAILURE,) omitted TIMED_OUT, a genuine gate-rejection shape the exclusion comment never actually named as deliberate. Both fixed same-session: find_named_check_conclusion now returns a dedicated AMBIGUOUS_CHECK_CONCLUSION sentinel on disagreeing duplicates (read by _classify_one as CANNOT-VERIFY, never guessed), and TIMED_OUT was added to RED_CHECK_CONCLUSIONS. 4 non-blockers triaged, not fixed, reasoning recorded in pack.yml dissent: mergeStateStatus BLOCKED/UNSTABLE never consulted (closed 5-cause set by mandate design); a TOCTOU window between the bulk discovery read and the per-PR fresh fetches; a pre-existing shepherd GC/partial-page interaction (bounded, self-healing per the reviewer's own assessment); and is_quarantined's fail-open on a malformed timestamp, which is an intentional, already-tested design choice (test_is_quarantined_malformed_timestamp_fails_open_to_retry_never_permanent_skip), not a bug.
